Copy the reference maid dress structure exactly: dark navy and white, the same collar/chest bow details, long sleeves and cuff details, same apron and small blue whale emblem, same skirt layers and lace, same pale legs/tights and navy shoes, same bright blue curved whale tail. Fine clean anime line art, soft cel shading and layered hair highlights matching the reference. The blurred text and pale background in the reference are NOT part of the character: omit them.
Real transparent alpha background; no floor, shadow, scenery, text, numbers, watermarks, added logos or props. Keep the existing whale emblem. Fixed camera, consistent scale and head size, every girl fully contained in her cell. Each full-body character centered horizontally; halo top at 18% of each cell height, shoe soles at 85%; character height approximately 67%, with at least 10% clear safe margins around every extremity. Every cell uses identical head size, hairstyle and outfit and fixed camera. Poses1 and6 must be the exact same neutral standing pose as the attached reference. SIX successive drawings: 1 reference neutral stand; 2 surprised with hands still low; 3 right hand fully raised in a friendly wave, left hand on chest; 4 both hands raised with open palms waving and happy closed eyes; 5 hands lowering, playful tilted head and wink; 6 exact reference neutral stand. Never add any colored glow, gradient, mist, shadow or vignette. Truly transparent pixels everywhere outside each character's outline, opaque clean character colors. Keep all six separate, whole and safely inside their cells.
